integrity: The analytic derivation supports all universal assertions; the accompanying runnable finite checks corroborate but do not replace the proof. No authorship or independent certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact theorem treats integer sphere dimensions d>=2, fixed 0<r<1 and first-order real axial modulation; finite-degree Jacobi cutoff only on S^2. Full text of 2026 motivating preprint was inaccessible and remains an originality risk; no independent verification has occurred.
title: Sharp axial tilts of spherical Poisson covariances: a dimension-free positivity threshold and universal critical kernels
